The wearable technology market is projected to reach $185 billion by 2030 with a 15% CAGR, indicating strong growth in fitness tracking and health monitoring devices. This trend is relevant to gym management software as wearables increasingly integrate with fitness platforms and provide data that gyms and trainers can leverage for member engagement and program optimization.
